IDiscussionboardGuests.description:

discussionboard_guests Prisma 모델 규정과 개인정보 최소화 원칙을 철저하게 준수하며, 유저 식별 외에는 어떤 세부 정보도 반환하지 않습니다.

필수 값은 id와 created_at이며, 기타 인증·개인식별 정보는 별도 테이블/서비스에서 관리합니다.

moderator_id.description:
The unique identifier of the moderator who issued the suspension. Maps to discussionboard_moderators.id.

This field enables traceability of disciplinary actions for compliance and audit purposes. Required to assign accountability for issuing a suspension.

suspended_member_id.description:
The unique identifier of the member being suspended. Maps to discussionboard_members.id.

This property enables linking the suspension to the affected member, supporting enforcement, compliance, and reactivation logic.

suspension_reason.description:
A clear textual explanation for why the suspension was issued (e.g., 'spamming', 'abuse of rules').

This field documents justification for the action, supporting transparency, appeals, and moderation review.

suspension_started_at.description:
The timestamp (RFC 3339) for when the suspension takes effect.

This supports audit trailing and timezone-independent policy enforcement.

oneOf.description:
The scheduled end timestamp (RFC 3339) for the suspension. Nullable for indefinite or until manual review.

This field enables temporary or permanent suspension durations as per business rules.

discussionboard_post_id.description: ID of the post this reaction was given to.

IDiscussionboardPostReaction.description: Post reaction object representing an individual emoji or symbolic response. All fields correspond to normalized columns in the discussionboard_post_reactions schema.

discussionboard_post_id.description: The UUID of the post to react to. Required. Maps to discussionboard_posts.id.

discussionboard_member_id.description: The UUID of the member giving the reaction. Required. Maps to discussionboard_members.id.

IDiscussionboardPostReaction.ICreate.description: Model for creating a new emoji or symbolic reaction to a post. Used for POST endpoints.

limit.description: Records per page; default 100.

IPage.IPagination.description: Pagination metadata for paginated result sets.

reaction_type.description:
The updated type of reaction (e.g., emoji name or standard literal), uniquely identifying the new reaction. This field corresponds to the atomic, normalized reaction value as defined in the discussionboard_post_reactions table, e.g., 'thumbs_up'.

When updating a reaction, this will typically be changed from a previous value, and must comply with business rules limiting duplicate reactions per user per post.

Required for changing the reaction type during an update operation.

IDiscussionboardPostReaction.IUpdate.description:
Update schema for post reaction objects. This type allows changing the specific reaction type, mapping to the reaction_type field in the discussionboard_post_reactions table. Used in endpoints allowing users to alter their emoji/symbolic reaction to a post.

All other primary key fields are immutable; only reaction_type can be changed during an update.

References only atomic data; does not include or allow modification of post/member linkage.

discussionboard_post_id.description:
Filter likes by the post ID (discussionboard_post_id) for which likes are to be retrieved. Optional; if omitted, all liked posts can be fetched.

References the atomic post entity the like targets.

discussionboard_member_id.description:
Filter likes by the member ID (discussionboard_member_id) who performed the like. Optional; when provided, only likes created by this member are included.

Supports per-user analytics/dashboard records.

Business logic typically restricts access to the requesting user's own likes unless admin/moderator.

IDiscussionboardPostLike.IRequest.description:
Request object for retrieving a list of post likes. Supports filtering by target post and/or liking member, reflecting discussionboard_post_likes schema fields.

All filtering and sorting operations refer to fields physically present in the schema (discussionboard_post_id, discussionboard_member_id).

data.description:
The array of post like records being returned in the current result page. Each entry conforms to the IDiscussionboardPostLike schema type, representing a single like record.

Derived directly from the discussionboard_post_likes table.

IPageIDiscussionboardPostLike.description:
Paginated container response type for post likes. Used to return a paged list of IDiscussionboardPostLike objects according to search/filter criteria, with pagination details for navigation and UI purposes.

All instances returned must align strictly to schema fields and business rules for engagement tracking.

id.description:
Primary Key. Unique identifier for the post like record. Used to distinguish each like uniquely in the database, supporting engagement analytics and delete operations.

Never duplicated in result sets; atomic value as per table.

discussionboard_post_id.description:
References the liked post's unique identifier. Maps to the discussionboard_posts entity which received the like.

Supports join and analytic queries targeting a post's likes.

discussionboard_member_id.description:
Identifies the member who performed the like, mapped to discussionboard_members table.

Critical for enforcing one-like-per-member posting and audit trails.

Personalized analytics and permission checks reference this value.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the post like was recorded for the audit trail and for chronological analytics.

Displayed for user dashboards and time-based reporting.

IDiscussionboardPostLike.description:
Schema definition for a single post like entity, strictly mapping to the discussionboard_post_likes table. Each property directly references the normalized fields of the post like: its unique ID, target post, member performing the like, and the time it was created.

Used in analytics, engagement dashboards, and like management features.

discussionboard_post_id.description:
Required. The post's unique ID for which the like will be created. Must correspond to an existing entry in discussionboard_posts.

Drives analytics, permissions, and engagement displays.

discussionboard_member_id.description:
Required. The member's unique ID (from discussionboard_members) performing the like. This must match the current authenticated user/session context for security and audit compliance.

Business logic will enforce a one-like-per-member-per-post rule (see unique constraint).

Never accept via client for another member.

IDiscussionboardPostLike.ICreate.description:
Payload for creating a new post like record. All required properties must correspond to fields defined in discussionboard_post_likes schema. Creation is only permitted for the authenticated member context (secure backend injects member_id).

Other fields (id, created_at) are set automatically at the backend and not settable from the client.

IDiscussionboardPostLike.IUpdate.description:
Update model for post like entities. There are no mutable fields in discussionboard_post_likes schema other than possibly updating the timestamp for internal use. This schema is provided for completeness but will typically be unused by frontend clients, as post like status is handled via create/erase endpoints.

No updatable fields are normally present; endpoint will reject or ignore input.

discussionboard_thread_id.description:
Optional. Used to filter polls by the associated thread's unique identifier. This restricts listing/searching polls to those attached to a specific thread, according to discussionboard_polls schema field.

Enables locating all polls relevant to a particular thread discussion.

created_by_member_id.description:
Optional. Filter to show only polls created by a specific member (maps to discussionboard_members). Used for personalized poll management, analytics, or moderation review.

Primary use: member dashboard, moderation context.

allow_multiple_choices.description:
Optional. Limits to polls with a specific value for the allow_multiple_choices configuration setting. Used for advanced filtering (e.g., return only polls with multi-select enabled).

Null or omitted to include both types in result.

is_anonymous.description:
Optional. Restricts results to polls by their anonymity setting. Typically used to search for all anonymous (or non-anonymous) polls via batch query.

Null/omitted includes both types in search.

expires_before.description:
Limits results to polls that expire before this date/time. Used for filtering for polls expiring soon or past due for archival/action.

Matches expiration criteria in discussionboard_polls schema.

ISO 8601 timestamp.

expires_after.description:
Limits results to polls that expire after this date/time. Use for querying active or future polls in analytics/audit workflows. Maps to the expires_at timestamp in schema.

Fields are returned in ISO 8601 format.

prompt.description:
Enables searching for polls by substring match against the prompt/question text. Used for keyword-based discovery, audit, and reporting workflows.

Null or omitted disables prompt text filtering.

IPoll.IRequest.description: Request object for listing/searching discussionboard_polls. All filters apply to properties mapped from the actual schema and support complex searching and analytics for engagement features. Optional properties align with fields in the polls schema.

data.description: The array of poll metadata objects comprising the current result page. Each entry references all schema-defined fields for a poll, matching the IPoll type.

IPageIPoll.description:
Paginated container for poll listing/search endpoints. Used to respond with pages of poll records plus navigational metadata. Aligns with standard paging structures on the platform.

Every poll in data array must match IPoll schema.

id.description: Primary Key. Unique ID of the poll. Uniquely identifies the poll record in the database and is used for join/audit operations.

discussionboard_thread_id.description: The thread's unique identifier (foreign key) for which this poll is attached. This field links the poll to its discussion context and supports analytics/navigation.

created_by_member_id.description:
Member (creator) ID. Refers to the member who created this poll (discussionboard_members.id). Used for authorizations, audit trail, and analytic attribution.

Set by backend based on authentication context at creation.

prompt.description:
Poll prompt/question text as shown to users. This field appears in discovery, search, and voting interfaces to define the poll's subject.

Required on creation; may be searched in listings.

allow_multiple_choices.description: True if this poll supports multi-select voting. Mapped directly to the normalized allow_multiple_choices field in the table. Required for enforcing poll logic in UI and backend.

is_anonymous.description: Indicates if the poll is anonymous. If true, voter identities are concealed. This supports compliance and privacy settings. Set at creation (immutable in some business logic).

expires_at.description:
Timestamp at which voting for this poll closes. If null, the poll never expires. Used for time-bound voting logic, archival, or announcement automation.

ISO 8601 format. Optional.

created_at.description: Timestamp denoting when the poll was created. Used for listing, analytics, and audit trail purposes.

IPoll.description:
Schema for a single poll record (discussionboard_polls). All properties map directly to fields in the table, used for engagement, analytics, and UI display.

Business rules are enforced via backend logic based on these fields; no fields omitted or derived.

discussionboard_thread_id.description: Required. Foreign key referencing the thread to which this poll is attached. Must reference an existing thread in the system.

prompt.description: Required. The poll's question text to display to users. Sets the subject/focus of voting.

allow_multiple_choices.description: Required. Set to true to allow multiple selection voting; otherwise, single vote per voter.

is_anonymous.description: Required. Specifies whether the poll is anonymous. If true, all voter identities are concealed (privacy feature).

expires_at.description: Optional. When this poll's voting closes (ISO 8601). If null, the poll never expires. Use for scheduling poll closure in policy/compliance scenarios.

IPoll.ICreate.description: Creation payload for a new poll. All required fields correspond to discussionboard_polls table. For each creatable poll, must specify the thread, question (prompt), configuration flags, and (optionally) expiration.

prompt.description: Optional update for the prompt/question text displayed in the poll. Used if the creator rewords the poll topic during edit.

allow_multiple_choices.description: Optional update to multi-select voting flag. Only changeable per policy rules; some polls may not allow this after initial votes.

is_anonymous.description: Optional update for the poll's anonymity setting. May be locked by business policy to ensure privacy if votes have been cast.

expires_at.description: Optional update to poll expiration timestamp. Used when rescheduling poll closure or re-opening polling in exceptional cases.

IPoll.IUpdate.description: Update fields for editing existing poll records. Mapped to updatable fields in discussionboard_polls schema. Not all field modifications may be permitted after votes are present; application logic must enforce business rules. Only updatable fields are included here.

discussionboard_poll_id.description: Optional. Limits query to votes for a particular poll (foreign key from poll voting entity). Used to group/search all ballots cast in a selected poll.

voting_member_id.description: Optional. Filter votes by a specific member's voting record (for personalized analytics or auditing of poll voting eligibility).

selected_option.description: Optional. Search for votes by the value of the option selected (enables vote-by-option reporting or anomaly detection where required).

IPollVote.IRequest.description: Query object for listing/searching votes in discussionboard_poll_votes. All search/filter properties must reference actual fields present in the schema. Used in endpoints supporting poll analytics and admin review.

current.description: Current page number. Index of the current result page (1-based).

limit.description: Maximum records per page (default 100).

records.description: Total number of records in database matching filter/search.

pages.description: Total number of pages calculated as total records divided by limit (ceiling).

IPage.IPagination.description:
Pagination object for all paginated listing APIs. Provides precise page navigation, total record set accounting, and UI-friendly navigation metadata.

Standard for all paginated collections in the open discussion board platform.

moderator_id.description: 해당 경고를 부여한 모더레이터(혹은 관리자)의 id입니다.

IWarningLog.description: 경고 로그 엔티티. 모더레이터/관리자가 회원에게 발급한 각 경고 내역을 기록. 발급자, 수신자, 사유, 시점 정보 포함.

moderator_id.description: 경고 발부자(모더레이터)의 id입니다. 반드시 인증 컨텍스트에서 추출.

issued_at.description: 경고 발부 시각(ISO8601). 서버에서 자동 생성 권장.

IWarningLog.ICreate.description: 경고 로그(WarningLog) 신규 생성 요청. 경고 발급자는 인증 컨텍스트에서 추출, reason과 시점은 비즈니스 로직 기준 필요.

IWarningLog.IUpdate.description:
경고 로그(WarningLog)에 대한 수정(갱신) 요청용 타입입니다.

수정이 허용된 필드만 포함, 경고 기록의 사유 및 시점 변경이 가능합니다.

oneOf.description: 정지 처분을 부여한 모더레이터/관리자 id (조회/필터 조건, 선택 입력).

moderator_id.description: 정지 처분을 부여한 모더레이터/관리자 id (조회/필터 조건, 선택 입력).

oneOf.description: 정지된 회원 id (검색/필터용).
정지 사유(부분검색 지원).
정지 시작일(이후).
정지 시작일(이전).
정지 종료 시점(이후).
정지 종료 시점(이전).
조회 페이지 번호(1기본).

page.description: 조회 페이지 번호(1기본).

oneOf.description: 페이지 당 결과 수(기본: 100).

limit.description: 페이지 당 결과 수(기본: 100).

ISuspension.IRequest.description:
정지 이력 검색용 요청 파라미터 타입.

모더레이터/회원/사유/시작-종료 기간별 필터와 페이지네이션 용도로 사용합니다.

pagination.description: 페이지네이션 정보. 현재 페이지, 전체 수 등 포함.

data.description: ISuspension 엔티티 배열.

IPageISuspension.description:
회원 정지(Suspension) 이력의 페이징 결과 타입입니다.

정지 이력 데이터와 pagination 정보를 제공합니다.

id.description: 정지 이력의 고유 id(PK, UUID).

moderator_id.description: 정지처분 액터 모더레이터(혹은 관리자)의 id.

oneOf.description: 정지 종료 예정일(null일 경우 무기한 정지 혹은 수동복구 필요).

suspension_ends_at.description: 정지 종료 예정일(null일 경우 무기한 정지 혹은 수동복구 필요).

ISuspension.description:
회원 정지 이력 엔티티. 모더레이터가 회원에 대해 정지를 부여한 내역을 관리/검색함.

정지 사유, 시점, 대상 회원, 액터 등의 정보를 포함하며, 종료일이 nullable인 점을 유의하십시오.

limit.description: 페이지 당 최대 노출 레코드 개수(기본 100).

records.description: 데이터베이스 전체 레코드(검색 결과 전체 수).

pages.description: 전체 페이지 개수(검색 결과 / 페이지 크기 + 올림).

IPage.IPagination.description:
페이지네이션 정보(공통 페이로드)

현재 페이지, 1페이지 당 레코드 수, 전체 row 개수, 전체 페이지 개수 등 페이지네이션을 위한 메타 정보를 제공합니다.

pagination.description: Page information, including current page, page size, total records, and pages. Used for paginated lists of discussion board platform policies.

data.description: Array of platform policy records on this page. Each element represents a single platform policy document.

IPageIDiscussionboardPlatformPolicy.description:
A paginated collection of platform policies for the discussion board.

This container includes an array of platform policy items coupled with pagination information, 
enabling clients to efficiently browse and filter policies as required for admin management and audit. Extends common IPage container semantics for consistent API patterns.

policy_code.description:
Unique policy code.

Serves as a distinct identifier for the platform policy, such as 'PRIVACY', 'MODERATION', etc. 
This is defined as unique within the discussionboard_platform_policies table, ensuring that policies can be referenced, updated, and managed precisely in administrative flows.

title.description:
Policy title.

Human-readable title of the platform policy, for use in UI listings and as a visible heading to users and administrators.

policy_text.description:
Full published text of the platform policy.

Contains the actual content/terms/rules that are presented to users. 
Complies with audit, transparency, and compliance requirements as detailed in the requirements documentation.

is_active.description:
Indicates whether the policy is currently active.

If true, this version is in force; otherwise, it is archived (but not deleted). Used to manage policy document lifecycle and platform compliance rules.

IDiscussionboardPlatformPolicy.ICreate.description:
Request body for creating a new discussion board platform policy.

All fields correspond to columns in the discussionboard_platform_policies table. This structure enables creation or publication of new official policies for platform governance, as detailed in Section 5 of the requirements.

id.description: Primary Key: Unique identifier for this platform policy record.

policy_code.description: Unique code for the policy, for use in routing, versioning, and audit.

title.description: Title of the policy document, suitable for end-user headings and admin management.

policy_text.description: Full text/content of the platform policy, as presented for legal and transparency requirements.

is_active.description:
Flag indicating whether this policy is currently in force (true) or has been superseded (false).

Policy lifecycle management is handled by toggling this value rather than deleting records.

published_at.description: Timestamp of policy publication (ISO 8601 format). Used for compliance and audit trails.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this record was last updated (ISO 8601 format).

IDiscussionboardPlatformPolicy.description:
Represents an official platform policy document in the discussion board.

This schema covers all published platform terms, moderation policies, and transparency documents per Section 5 of requirements. All fields map directly to the database columns and support compliance/audit workflows as well as end-user communications.

policy_code.description: Unique policy code of the platform policy to be changed (must match an existing record).

title.description: New/updated title of the policy document.

policy_text.description: Updated policy document text. Should be a complete legal/operational text string.

is_active.description: Set to true if this version should be current; false to retire/supersede this policy.

IDiscussionboardPlatformPolicy.IUpdate.description:
Request body for updating an existing platform policy document.

All fields correspond to columns in the discussionboard_platform_policies table. Only records referenced by policy_code will be updated. Used by admins to revise or replace policy text, titles, or activation state.

action_type.description: Optional filter on audit log action type (such as 'RULE_EDIT', 'SUSPENSION_APPLY').

actor_id.description: Optional filter for the uuid of the actor (user/admin/moderator/member) who performed the action. If omitted, search is not filtered by actor.

target_id.description: Optional filter on the target entity (user, post, policy, etc.).

created_from.description: ISO 8601 start time for filter window. Only logs created at or after this timestamp will be included.

created_to.description: ISO 8601 end time for filter window. Only logs created at or before this timestamp will be included.

keyword.description: Text search for keywords within the description to find audit events of interest.

page.description: Page number for paginated results. 1-based index; defaults to 1.

limit.description: Number of records per page to return. Used for pagination.

IDiscussionboardAuditLog.IRequest.description:
Defines search, filter, pagination, and keyword-lookup options for paginated retrieval of audit logs.

Allows complex search scenarios and supports compliance/business requirements for transparency and traceability of all sensitive operations. All field names align to queryable columns in the discussionboard_audit_logs schema.

pagination.description: Pagination meta for audit log list result (current page, limit, total records, total pages).

data.description: Audit log entries on this page/results slice.

IPageIDiscussionboardAuditLog.description:
Paginated result set for audit log queries in the discussion board audit log system.

Consists of pagination meta and an array of audit events, as required for compliance, management, and audit purposes.

id.description: Unique ID for this audit log record.

description.description: Free-text description of the action/event for compliance reporting and traceability.

oneOf.description: UUID of actor (admin/mod/member), if available. Null for system-initiated actions.

actor_id.description: UUID of actor (admin/mod/member), if available. Null for system-initiated actions.

oneOf.description: UUID of the primary entity affected, such as user, post, or policy. Nullable for system-wide or broad actions.

target_id.description: UUID of the primary entity affected, such as user, post, or policy. Nullable for system-wide or broad actions.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when this audit event was recorded, ISO 8601.

IDiscussionboardAuditLog.description:
Atomic audit log record for all sensitive actions in the system.

Tracks actor, action, and target at high fidelity, supporting business rules for compliance, forensic review, and change tracking per requirement documentation.

status.description: Optional filter by incident status, e.g., 'OPEN', 'IN_REVIEW', 'CLOSED', 'ESCALATED'.

incident_code.description: Optional filter by externally-assigned incident code/ID.

reporter_id.description: Limit results to those filed by a particular user. Null to ignore.

keyword.description: Keyword or phrase to search in the incident description/body.

page.description: Page number for paged result. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Page size. Number of results per page. Defaults to standard page size.

IDiscussionboardIncidentReport.IRequest.description:
Structure to enable advanced searching, filtering, and pagination of incident reports per the business and compliance requirements.

Enables precise triage and review of incident management workloads, as described in the requirements on escalations, user-facing reporting, and SLAs.

pagination.description: Standard pagination metadata for incident reports returned (current page, total, page size, etc.).

data.description: List of incident report records matching the requested search/filter criteria.

IPageIDiscussionboardIncidentReport.description:
Container for a paginated incident report result set.

This structure allows system admins and moderators to manage large volumes of compliance reports efficiently, in accordance with incident workflow requirements and transparency policies.

incident_code.description: Externally-identifiable unique incident code for tracking and workflow (e.g., 'INCIDENT-YYYYMMDD-001').

status.description: Initial status for the incident report (e.g., 'OPEN', 'IN_REVIEW').

oneOf.description: Optional; reporting user's UUID. May be null for anonymous reporting.

reporter_id.description: Optional; reporting user's UUID. May be null for anonymous reporting.

description.description: Free-text detailed statement of the incident for audit/triage.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the report is initially created (ISO 8601).

updated_at.description: Timestamp of most recent change or action (ISO 8601).

IDiscussionboardIncidentReport.ICreate.description:
Request object to submit a new compliance incident report.

Allows authorized users to initiate policy enforcement or audit workflows, recording all critical identifying and descriptive information for compliance and record-keeping.

id.description: Unique, system-assigned ID value for the incident report (PK in table).

incident_code.description: Externally-visible incident code. Used in workflow, search, and audit.

status.description: Incident workflow state such as 'OPEN', 'IN_REVIEW', 'CLOSED', or 'ESCALATED'. Used for policy/process automation.

oneOf.description: Reporting user's UUID (may be null if anonymous).

reporter_id.description: Reporting user's UUID (may be null if anonymous).

description.description: Full, user- or mod-provided description of the incident and context. Used as the audit trail.

created_at.description: Time at which the incident was reported (ISO 8601).

updated_at.description: Latest workflow/processing timestamp for this incident (ISO 8601).

IDiscussionboardIncidentReport.description:
Represents an incident report record in the Board's policy and compliance system.

Contains all information necessary for workflow, audit trail, and escalation as mandated by governance documentation.

incident_code.description: Externally visible code for this incident. Must map to an existing report to be updated.

status.description: New workflow status for the incident (policy/process-driven, e.g., 'IN_REVIEW', 'CLOSED').

oneOf.description: Reporter's UUID (can be omitted if not changing).

reporter_id.description: Reporter's UUID (can be omitted if not changing).

description.description: Updated or corrected description. Preserves full audit trail in the workflow.

updated_at.description: Timestamp for 'last updated'-type event (ISO 8601, set by system).

IDiscussionboardIncidentReport.IUpdate.description:
Describes allowed fields for an update to a specific incident report record.

Fields map to the columns in the discussionboard_incident_reports table and enable administrative or moderation-side corrections, workflow actions, or additions as audits progress.

limit.description: Limit (number of records per page, default 100).

pages.description: Total number of pages for given limit.

IPage.IPagination.description: Standard pagination meta container used throughout all list endpoints.

pagination.description: Page information for the current page of posts, including current page, limit, record count, and total page count. See IPage.IPagination for details.

data.description: List of post objects for the current result window. Each post object conforms to IDiscussionboardPosts schema.

IPageIDiscussionboardPosts.description:
A paginated response for searching or listing posts in the discussion board. This is a generic container type used for APIs that return pages of post records as a result of filters, queries, or list operations. Based on the standard IPage<T> container design recommended by the platform.

The data array contains all posts for the current page, and pagination describes how the result relates to the entire data set.

id.description: Primary key of the post record. Unique UUID assigned to each post on creation. Corresponds to the primary key in the schema discussionboard_posts.id.

discussionboard_thread_id.description: Foreign key for the thread this post belongs to. Points to discussionboard_threads.id. Required. Used to group posts within a thread.

discussionboard_member_id.description: Foreign key to the member who authored this post. Points to discussionboard_members.id. This field is always set by server from the authenticated user context. Never settable by clients in creation requests.

oneOf.description: Optional foreign key to the parent post (for comments or replies). Null if the post is a root post, otherwise points to another post in the current thread.
Optional foreign key to the parent post (for comments or replies). Null if the post is a root post, otherwise points to another post in the current thread.

parent_post_id.description: Optional foreign key to the parent post (for comments or replies). Null if the post is a root post, otherwise points to another post in the current thread.

body.description: Main body content for the post. Required string. Arbitrary UTF-8 text.

is_edited.description: Whether this post was edited after initial creation. Used for displaying 'edited' status and for audit/moderation.

is_deleted.description: Soft-deletion flag. true if this post is hidden from normal user view, false otherwise. A soft-deleted post remains in the database for admin/moderator access.

created_at.description: Timestamp for when the post was created, in ISO8601/RFC3339 date-time format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp for last mutation of the post (e.g., edit, soft-delete, or moderation action), in ISO8601/RFC3339 date-time format.

IDiscussionboardPosts.description:
A single post or comment within a thread, as modeled in the discussionboard_posts table. This includes both top-level posts and replies/comments (nested via parent_post_id). Each post consists of an author, potential parent post, content, audit and state metadata, and is timestamped for audit and display.

Sensitive fields (such as password, auth context) are strictly omitted. Only actual schema columns are included.

Complex properties such as permissions are managed by the application, not the data shape.

The parent_post_id field enables the nested comment structure, but is null for top-level posts.

The is_deleted flag is used for soft deletion as required by business and moderation policies.

discussionboard_thread_id.description: Foreign key to the parent thread (discussionboard_threads.id) for the new post. Required for associating the post to a specific thread.

oneOf.description: Optional foreign key for the parent post for replies/comments. Null if making a new root post.
Optional foreign key for the parent post for replies/comments. Null if making a new root post.

parent_post_id.description: Optional foreign key for the parent post for replies/comments. Null if making a new root post.

body.description: Body text for the post. Must be present; checked for length and content validation by backend.

is_edited.description: Should be set to false by default on initial creation, but accepted for up-front setting if required.

IDiscussionboardPosts.ICreate.description:
Request body shape for creating a new discussion board post. Only accepts fields that are required by the Prisma schema or business context:
- discussionboard_thread_id (required)
- parent_post_id (nullable, for replies/comments)
- body (required)
- is_edited (optional, defaults to false if not supplied)

The author/member is always set by the server based on authentication; client must not supply discussionboard_member_id.

is_deleted, created_at, and updated_at are managed server-side and must never be supplied in creation requests.

body.description: If present, the new text body content for the post. May be required based on endpoint; see documentation for which fields are mandatory in update requests.

is_edited.description: If present, declares whether the post is marked as edited as the result of this update action. Set true when performing a real edit; optional.

updated_at.description: Timestamp for when the update occurs (required if the business logic demands client-driven timestamps; otherwise set on backend).

IDiscussionboardPost.IUpdate.description:
Request body shape for updating an existing post. Only fields mutable by the client may appear:
- body (string): new content of the post; typically required, but in some APIs may be optional if only updating other flags
- is_edited (boolean): marks the post as edited
- updated_at (date-time): the timestamp for the update as per backend policy (if permitted)

No support for updating the author, creation date, thread, or id—these must always be immutable or managed by the backend. Never supply is_deleted field; soft-delete is via separate endpoint.

id.description: Primary key of the post record. Unique UUID assigned to each post on creation. Corresponds to the primary key in the schema discussionboard_posts.id.

discussionboard_thread_id.description: Foreign key for the thread this post belongs to. Points to discussionboard_threads.id. Required. Used to group posts within a thread.

discussionboard_member_id.description: Foreign key to the member who authored this post. Points to discussionboard_members.id. This field is always set by server from the authenticated user context. Never settable by clients in creation requests.

oneOf.description: Optional foreign key to the parent post (for comments or replies). Null if the post is a root post, otherwise points to another post in the current thread.
Optional foreign key to the parent post (for comments or replies). Null if the post is a root post, otherwise points to another post in the current thread.

parent_post_id.description: Optional foreign key to the parent post (for comments or replies). Null if the post is a root post, otherwise points to another post in the current thread.

body.description: Main body content for the post. Required string. Arbitrary UTF-8 text.

is_edited.description: Whether this post was edited after initial creation. Used for displaying 'edited' status and for audit/moderation.

is_deleted.description: Soft-deletion flag. true if this post is hidden from normal user view, false otherwise. A soft-deleted post remains in the database for admin/moderator access.

created_at.description: Timestamp for when the post was created, in ISO8601/RFC3339 date-time format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp for last mutation of the post (e.g., edit, soft-delete, or moderation action), in ISO8601/RFC3339 date-time format.

IDiscussionboardPost.description:
A single post or comment in the discussion board, representing a normalized record from the discussionboard_posts table. Matches properties and structure exactly. Used for response bodies for GET-one, GET-many, and detail search APIs.

Sensitive or security properties (such as password, authentication details) are always omitted for compliance with security best practices. Business context fields for auditing or permissions are not included—these are viewed as separate responsibilities handled at the application/service layer.

discussionboard_post_id.description: (Optional) Post id for which to filter histories. Use to retrieve all edit histories for a particular post.

edit_member_id.description: (Optional) Member id who performed the edit action. Filter histories associated with a specific member.

edit_type.description: (Optional) Edit type filter (e.g., 'edit', 'delete', 'restore'). Matches exact value in edit_type field in post history schema.

created_at_from.description: (Optional) Lower bound for creation timestamp of history log (inclusive filter). Use ISO8601/RFC3339 formatting.

created_at_to.description: (Optional) Upper bound for creation timestamp of history log (inclusive filter). Use ISO8601/RFC3339 formatting.

IPostHistory.IRequest.description:
Request query shape for searching or filtering post history snapshots. All parameters are optional and serve as filters:
- discussionboard_post_id: limit to a given post
- edit_member_id: show only changes by this member
- edit_type: filter for type of edit action
- created_at_from, created_at_to: restrict by history's creation timestamp window

Any combination of filters can be supplied for advanced queries. Not all properties are required.

pagination.description: Page info for result window, including current/limit/total/records/etc per the IPage.IPagination contract.

data.description: List of post history records for the current result window. Follows IPostHistory schema.

IPageIPostHistory.description: A paginated set of post history snapshot entities for audit, moderation, compliance, or member review UIs. Combines post history records with standard platform pagination for scalable/discoverable queries.

id.description: Primary key for this post history snapshot. UUID assigned on creation.

discussionboard_post_id.description: Foreign key: references the associated post in discussionboard_posts.

edit_member_id.description: Foreign key: references the member who performed the edit/action in this history entry.

oneOf.description: The post body content BEFORE the edit/action (if applicable). Null if this is the initial creation of the post, or if the edit type doesn't include a before state.
The post body content BEFORE the edit/action (if applicable). Null if this is the initial creation of the post, or if the edit type doesn't include a before state.

old_body.description: The post body content BEFORE the edit/action (if applicable). Null if this is the initial creation of the post, or if the edit type doesn't include a before state.

oneOf.description: The post body content AFTER the edit/action (if applicable). Null for non-content-mutating actions (e.g., soft-delete snapshot).
The post body content AFTER the edit/action (if applicable). Null for non-content-mutating actions (e.g., soft-delete snapshot).

new_body.description: The post body content AFTER the edit/action (if applicable). Null for non-content-mutating actions (e.g., soft-delete snapshot).

edit_type.description: Type of edit/action that led to this post history snapshot—e.g., 'edit', 'delete', 'restore', etc. Used for filtering and workflow analysis.

oneOf.description: Explanation/reason for the edit/action as recorded by the member or moderator. Nullable; may be blank for simple auto-edits.
Explanation/reason for the edit/action as recorded by the member or moderator. Nullable; may be blank for simple auto-edits.

edit_reason.description: Explanation/reason for the edit/action as recorded by the member or moderator. Nullable; may be blank for simple auto-edits.

created_at.description: Timestamp for when this history/snapshot record was created, in ISO8601/RFC3339 format.

IPostHistory.description:
A snapshot representing an edit, deletion, or moderation action on a post, recorded for audit and moderation purposes. Models the structure of the discussionboard_post_histories entity as a normalized audit log.

Each history record can contain both the old and new post body, as well as the edit type, editor, and timing. The record acts as an immutable log for resolving disputes, supporting appeals, or compliance audits. Not all entries have both old_body and new_body (e.g., creation/deletion snapshots may be partly empty).

edit_type.description: If present, new edit type for the post edit history snapshot. Used for corrections, e.g., changing 'temp-delete' to 'delete'.

edit_reason.description: Updated reason for the edit (if changed/clarified as part of audit or member edit).

new_body.description: Updated post body after the edit (if changing previously submitted body).

IPostHistory.IUpdate.description:
Request body for updating a post edit history record. Permits mutation of:
- edit_type (reason for the update)
- edit_reason (moderator/user-supplied reason for change)
- new_body (post content after the change)

id, discussionboard_post_id, and edit_member_id are always immutable and absent from this update type.

discussionboard_post_id.description: (Optional) The post id for which to filter edit log records.

edit_member_id.description: (Optional) Member id who performed the edit in log. Use to filter for own activity or moderator/admin searches.

change_summary.description: (Optional) Filter for edit records where the change_summary field matches the query.

created_at_from.description: (Optional) Lower bound for edit log's creation timestamp (inclusive).

created_at_to.description: (Optional) Upper bound for edit log's creation timestamp (inclusive).

IPostEditLog.IRequest.description: Request shape for searching/editing log entries for posts. All query properties are optional filters. May include post id, editor id, summary filter, and creation date time window. Used for audit, compliance, and member transparency features.

pagination.description: Page info for result window, including current/limit/total/records/etc per the IPage.IPagination contract.

data.description: List of post edit log records for the current result page. Each follows the IPostEditLog schema.

IPageIPostEditLog.description: A paginated page of post edit log records, supporting scalable audit and compliance review. Used in moderator/member/admin audit trails.

id.description: Primary key for this post edit log record. UUID assigned at log creation.

discussionboard_post_id.description: Foreign key: references the post edited in this action.

edit_member_id.description: Foreign key: references the member who performed this edit.

change_summary.description: Short, human-readable summary describing the change for this log entry. Used to help users/moderators quickly scan audit history.

change_details.description: Long-form or structured JSON/text containing detailed information about the edit. Used for compliance and dispute resolution.

created_at.description: Timestamp for when the edit log was created, in ISO8601/RFC3339 format.

IPostEditLog.description: A single record of a post edit, forming an audit trail for moderation and compliance. Matches discussionboard_post_edit_logs schema in the backend. Used for investigation, member transparency, and UI review of edit history.

current.description: Current page number (zero-based index for internal logic, one-based for user interfaces).

limit.description: Maximum number of records per page (pagination limit). Often fixed system default (e.g., 100), but can be set lower by user request or system policy.

records.description: Total number of records in the database for the entire query, not just this page.

pages.description: Total number of pages, computed as ceil(records/limit).

IPage.IPagination.description: Describes pagination of a result set, including current page, page size, total records, and total pages.

id.description:

search_query.description:
The exact query string that was used in the user's search operation.

Referenced directly from the `discussionboard_search_histories` schema, this property records the entered search phrase for analytics, recall, or future search suggestions. For example, if a user types 'election policy debate', that phrase is stored in this field. This field is atomic and not computed or derived.

oneOf.description:
Serialized list of filters (such as tags, sections, etc.) that were applied in the search.

Referenced from `discussionboard_search_histories`, this value records any user-selected filters, such as: 'tag:macroeconomics,section:current_events'. May be null if no filters were used at the time of search.

executed_at.description:
Timestamp of when the search was performed (ISO 8601 format).

Sourced from the Prisma schema's `executed_at` field, this property logs the precise search initiation time for both analytics and audit-trail. Example: '2025-07-29T06:22:29.087Z'.

oneOf.description:

operations.summary: Hard delete an appeal record from the discussionboard_appeals table by ID (no soft delete).

parameters.name: appealId
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the appeal (`discussionboard_appeals.id`).

responseBody.description: Confirmation of deletion (usually null or basic status).

operations.name: erase

filters.description:
Filtering criteria for configuration list queries.

Allows fine-grained queries across IDiscussionboardConfiguration fields using exact match or pattern searching for id (uuid), name, and description. Should support at least equality, partial matches, and advanced conditions per admin interface requirements.

sort.description:
Sort criteria for ordering configuration results.

A list of field names (with optional direction, e.g. 'name:asc', 'created_at:desc') to control display order in response. Must be fields actually present in the configuration table.

page.description:
The result page number starting at 1.

If not set, defaults to the first page.

limit.description:
Page size: number of configuration records per page.

This is a soft constraint to prevent very large result sets. Typically 10~100.

No deletion fields are present; modification is via update, not deletion.

name.description:

Defines the identifier of the configuration in admin tools and internal code. Must meet database uniqueness constraints.

settings_json.description:
Serialized configuration settings as JSON.

Stores all customizable configuration options. Value must be valid JSON (string form), not a parsed object.

oneOf.description:

Human-readable explanation or business notes for the configuration; nullable if not supplied.

IDiscussionboardConfiguration.IUpdate.description:
Payload for updating an existing configuration entry.

Admin update operation: supplies only fields that are mutable (does not touch PK or related audit logs). All fields are optional; omitting a field leaves existing value unchanged.

id.description:

UUID of the configuration that was removed.

Response for successful deletion of a configuration entry. Returns the UUID id of the configuration removed.

No other fields are returned in a standard delete result.

IDiscussionboardSection.description:
Discussion board section entity definition.

Represents a primary division/group above categories for board organization, content control, and admin policy enforcement. Aligns directly to the Prisma schema table and all UI/admin policies concerning section state. Never soft/hard deleted—visibility altered via enabled field.

discussionboard_configuration_id.description:

Payload for updating an existing board section entry.

Fields are all optional for PATCH/PUT update; omit any to preserve existing value. No id/pk or audit fields are mutated in this DTO.

id.description:
Section's UUID primary key.

IDiscussionboardSection.IDeleteResult.description:
Response object for successful section hard delete.

Returns the id of the deleted section for client-side reconciliation. No metadata or extra properties included.

관리자 역할 배정 엔티티 타입입니다.

Prisma의 discussionboard_admins 테이블 전체 컬럼 대비, id, created_at 필드만 정의되어 있습니다. 관리자 권한의 부여 및 감사/조회의 엔티티 단위로 사용합니다.

외부 user/member 엔티티와 1:1 매핑하는 uuid 값.

IDiscussionboardAdmin.ICreate.description:
관리자 역할 할당 요청 바디 타입.
이에 직접적으로 password, creator_id 등 민감정보가 포함되지 않으며 인증과정에서만 외부 인증이 요구됨. Prisma schema 구조에 맞춰 요청 값을 제공합니다.

IPageIDiscussionboardModerator.description: discussionboard_moderators 목록을 페이징 결과로 리턴하는 컨테이너입니다.

고유한 모더레이터 역할 식별자입니다. discussionboard_moderators 테이블의 주 키로, 시스템 내 역할 할당을 명확히 추적합니다.

각 모더레이터 배정 문서에 사용되며, 다른 도메인(멤버/유저)과 외래키로 연관될 수 있습니다.

created_at.description:
모더레이터 역할이 부여된 시점을 나타내는 타임스탬프입니다.

감사 추적, 커뮤니티 신뢰도 분석, 역할 변동 이력 확인에 반드시 필요합니다.

IDiscussionboardModerator.description:
정치·경제 토론 게시판에서 커뮤니티 관리를 담당하는 모더레이터 역할 배정 정보를 정의합니다.

requirements analysis 문서와 Prisma discussionboard_moderators 모델(Actors) 설명에 근거하여, 각 배정 건의 식별자와 역할 시작 시점만 엄격히 기록합니다. 모든 속성은 정규화 규칙과 개인정보 보호 원칙을 중점적으로 반영합니다.

id.description: 부여할 모더레이터 역할의 고유 식별자입니다. 멤버/유저의 ID와 매핑되는 UUID이며, 외부 참조에서 유효성이 보장되어야 합니다.

created_at.description: 모더레이터 권한이 할당된 실제 일시로, 시스템 레벨에서 기록/자동 부여합니다.

IDiscussionboardModerator.ICreate.description:

discussionboard_moderators 테이블의 구조를 그대로 따라, 해당 역할 할당의 유일 식별자와 부여 일시만 포함합니다. 추가 개인정보나 계정정보, 'deleted_at', 'assigned_by' 등은 절대 포함하지 않습니다.

id.description: 수정 대상 모더레이터 배정 레코드의 고유 식별자입니다.

created_at.description: 모더레이터 권한 배정 일시로, 필요한 경우 갱신될 수 있습니다.

IDiscussionboardModerator.IUpdate.description:
기존 모더레이터 역할 배정 정보를 수정할 때 사용하는 타입입니다.

수정 가능한 속성은 schema 상 명시된 필드뿐이며, 특히 사적으로 처리되어야 하는 추가 메타데이터, 삭제 플래그, 감사 로그 등은 포함하지 않습니다.

title.description: 토론 스레드의 제목. 한 줄 요약 또는 메인 문장.

status.description: 스레드 상태: 예) 'active', 'archived', 'locked' 등. 사업로직상 논의 활성/잠금/종료 컨트롤 용도.

is_locked.description: 스레드 잠금 여부. true일 경우 추가 댓글/업데이트 금지.

archived.description: 스레드가 아카이브된(숨김) 상태인지 여부. true면 일반 회원이 시청 불가.

created_at.description: 스레드 생성일시.

updated_at.description: 스레드 최종 수정일시(댓글/수정/잠금/핀 등 이벤트 반영).

IDiscussionboardThreads.description:
discussionboard_threads 메인 엔터티의 스키마 명세.

- 스레드 고유 식별자, 작성자, 소속 카테고리 FK
- 제목, 상태, 핀/잠금/아카이브 상태 플래그, 생성 및 최종 수정 타임스탬프

기존 soft/hard delete 개념 대신 archived로 숨김 처리합니다. 각 컬럼은 ERD 및 비즈니스 설명과 완벽하게 매칭되어 시스템 내 일관성 및 완전성을 보장합니다.

discussionboard_member_id.description: 스레드 생성자(회원) UUID ● 서버 측에서 인증 컨텍스트로 결정됨. 클라이언트 입력 시 무시.

title.description: 스레드 제목. 반드시 포함해야 함.

status.description: 스레드 상태 ('active' 등). 기본값/초기값 필요시 서버 측에서 설정.

is_pinned.description: 생성 시 핀 여부 지정. 일반적으로 false.

created_at.description: 생성 시점(ISO 8601).

updated_at.description: 생성 시점과 동일하게 초기화.

IDiscussionboardThreads.ICreate.description:
새 토론 스레드(discussionboard_threads 엔티티) 생성 요청 DTO입니다.

작성자, 카테고리, 제목, 상태, 핀여부, 잠금여부, 아카이브, 생성/수정시각 등 실제 Prisma 스키마 컬럼에 해당하는 필드만 포함합니다.

보안상 discussionboard_member_id는 서버 인증 정보로 채워지며 직접 입력은 허용하지 않습니다.

title.description: 스레드 제목(수정).

status.description: 상태 마크('active', 'locked', 'archived' 등).

updated_at.description:
마지막 수정시각. 필수.

스레드 소유자, 관리자가 접근하여 필요한 상태를 변경합니다.

IDiscussionboardThreads.IUpdate.description:
discussionboard_threads 엔터티(스레드)의 주요 속성 수정/갱신 요청 DTO입니다.

작성자와 생성일시는 변경할 수 없으며, 카테고리·제목·상태·핀/잠금 여부·아카이브·갱신시각만 허용합니다.

특정 필드는 수정 시점마다 업데이트가 강제됩니다.

id.description: 포스트(댓글/본문)의 고유 식별자(PK).

discussionboard_thread_id.description: 해당 포스트가 소속된 스레드의 UUID FK.

discussionboard_member_id.description: 작성 회원의 UUID(FK).

parent_post_id.description: 상위 댓글(답글 연결시)의 UUID, 루트 포스트인 경우 null.

body.description: 댓글/포스트의 본문(텍스트 원문).

is_edited.description: 수정 여부 플래그. 편집·이력 관리 용도.

is_deleted.description: 본 댓글이 삭제(숨김) 상태인지 여부. soft-delete 전용.

created_at.description: 포스트 생성일시.

updated_at.description: 포스트 최종 수정/갱신 시각.

IDiscussionboardPosts.IRequest.description: 댓글/포스트 목록·검색 및 필터링 요청 DTO(discussionboard_posts 테이블). 각 필드는 실제 DB의 컬럼과 정확히 매칭됩니다.

pagination.description: Page information for the current page of posts, including current page, limit, record count, and total page count. See IPage.IPagination for details.

data.description: List of post objects for the current result window. Each post object conforms to IDiscussionboardPosts schema.

IPageIDiscussionboardPosts.description:
A paginated response for searching or listing posts in the discussion board. This is a generic container type used for APIs that return pages of post records as a result of filters, queries, or list operations. Based on the standard IPage<T> container design recommended by the platform.

The data array contains all posts for the current page, and pagination describes how the result relates to the entire data set.

id.description: Primary key of the post record. Unique UUID assigned to each post on creation. Corresponds to the primary key in the schema discussionboard_posts.id.

discussionboard_thread_id.description: Foreign key for the thread this post belongs to. Points to discussionboard_threads.id. Required. Used to group posts within a thread.

discussionboard_member_id.description: Foreign key to the member who authored this post. Points to discussionboard_members.id. This field is always set by server from the authenticated user context. Never settable by clients in creation requests.

oneOf.description: Optional foreign key to the parent post (for comments or replies). Null if the post is a root post, otherwise points to another post in the current thread.
Optional foreign key to the parent post (for comments or replies). Null if the post is a root post, otherwise points to another post in the current thread.

parent_post_id.description: Optional foreign key to the parent post (for comments or replies). Null if the post is a root post, otherwise points to another post in the current thread.

body.description: Main body content for the post. Required string. Arbitrary UTF-8 text.

is_edited.description: Whether this post was edited after initial creation. Used for displaying 'edited' status and for audit/moderation.

is_deleted.description: Soft-deletion flag. true if this post is hidden from normal user view, false otherwise. A soft-deleted post remains in the database for admin/moderator access.

created_at.description: Timestamp for when the post was created, in ISO8601/RFC3339 date-time format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp for last mutation of the post (e.g., edit, soft-delete, or moderation action), in ISO8601/RFC3339 date-time format.

IDiscussionboardPosts.description:
A single post or comment within a thread, as modeled in the discussionboard_posts table. This includes both top-level posts and replies/comments (nested via parent_post_id). Each post consists of an author, potential parent post, content, audit and state metadata, and is timestamped for audit and display.

Sensitive fields (such as password, auth context) are strictly omitted. Only actual schema columns are included.

Complex properties such as permissions are managed by the application, not the data shape.

The parent_post_id field enables the nested comment structure, but is null for top-level posts.

The is_deleted flag is used for soft deletion as required by business and moderation policies.

discussionboard_thread_id.description: Foreign key to the parent thread (discussionboard_threads.id) for the new post. Required for associating the post to a specific thread.

oneOf.description: Optional foreign key for the parent post for replies/comments. Null if making a new root post.
Optional foreign key for the parent post for replies/comments. Null if making a new root post.

parent_post_id.description: Optional foreign key for the parent post for replies/comments. Null if making a new root post.

body.description: Body text for the post. Must be present; checked for length and content validation by backend.

is_edited.description: Should be set to false by default on initial creation, but accepted for up-front setting if required.

IDiscussionboardPosts.ICreate.description:
Request body shape for creating a new discussion board post. Only accepts fields that are required by the Prisma schema or business context:
- discussionboard_thread_id (required)
- parent_post_id (nullable, for replies/comments)
- body (required)
- is_edited (optional, defaults to false if not supplied)

The author/member is always set by the server based on authentication; client must not supply discussionboard_member_id.

is_deleted, created_at, and updated_at are managed server-side and must never be supplied in creation requests.

body.description: If present, the new text body content for the post. May be required based on endpoint; see documentation for which fields are mandatory in update requests.

is_edited.description: If present, declares whether the post is marked as edited as the result of this update action. Set true when performing a real edit; optional.

updated_at.description: Timestamp for when the update occurs (required if the business logic demands client-driven timestamps; otherwise set on backend).

IDiscussionboardPost.IUpdate.description:
Request body shape for updating an existing post. Only fields mutable by the client may appear:
- body (string): new content of the post; typically required, but in some APIs may be optional if only updating other flags
- is_edited (boolean): marks the post as edited
- updated_at (date-time): the timestamp for the update as per backend policy (if permitted)

No support for updating the author, creation date, thread, or id—these must always be immutable or managed by the backend. Never supply is_deleted field; soft-delete is via separate endpoint.

Optional foreign key to the parent post (for comments or replies). Null if the post is a root post, otherwise points to another post in the current thread.

is_edited.description: Whether this post was edited after initial creation. Used for displaying 'edited' status and for audit/moderation.

is_deleted.description: Soft-deletion flag. true if this post is hidden from normal user view, false otherwise. A soft-deleted post remains in the database for admin/moderator access.

updated_at.description: Timestamp for last mutation of the post (e.g., edit, soft-delete, or moderation action), in ISO8601/RFC3339 date-time format.

IDiscussionboardPost.description:
A single post or comment in the discussion board, representing a normalized record from the discussionboard_posts table. Matches properties and structure exactly. Used for response bodies for GET-one, GET-many, and detail search APIs.

Sensitive or security properties (such as password, authentication details) are always omitted for compliance with security best practices. Business context fields for auditing or permissions are not included—these are viewed as separate responsibilities handled at the application/service layer.

discussionboard_post_id.description: (Optional) Post id for which to filter histories. Use to retrieve all edit histories for a particular post.

edit_member_id.description: (Optional) Member id who performed the edit action. Filter histories associated with a specific member.

edit_type.description: (Optional) Edit type filter (e.g., 'edit', 'delete', 'restore'). Matches exact value in edit_type field in post history schema.

created_at_from.description: (Optional) Lower bound for creation timestamp of history log (inclusive filter). Use ISO8601/RFC3339 formatting.

created_at_to.description: (Optional) Upper bound for creation timestamp of history log (inclusive filter). Use ISO8601/RFC3339 formatting.

IPostHistory.IRequest.description:
Request query shape for searching or filtering post history snapshots. All parameters are optional and serve as filters:
- discussionboard_post_id: limit to a given post
- edit_member_id: show only changes by this member
- edit_type: filter for type of edit action
- created_at_from, created_at_to: restrict by history's creation timestamp window

Any combination of filters can be supplied for advanced queries. Not all properties are required.

pagination.description: Page info for result window, including current/limit/total/records/etc per the IPage.IPagination contract.

data.description: List of post history records for the current result window. Follows IPostHistory schema.

IPageIPostHistory.description: A paginated set of post history snapshot entities for audit, moderation, compliance, or member review UIs. Combines post history records with standard platform pagination for scalable/discoverable queries.

id.description: Primary key for this post history snapshot. UUID assigned on creation.

discussionboard_post_id.description: Foreign key: references the associated post in discussionboard_posts.

edit_member_id.description: Foreign key: references the member who performed the edit/action in this history entry.

oneOf.description: The post body content BEFORE the edit/action (if applicable). Null if this is the initial creation of the post, or if the edit type doesn't include a before state.
The post body content BEFORE the edit/action (if applicable). Null if this is the initial creation of the post, or if the edit type doesn't include a before state.

old_body.description: The post body content BEFORE the edit/action (if applicable). Null if this is the initial creation of the post, or if the edit type doesn't include a before state.

oneOf.description: The post body content AFTER the edit/action (if applicable). Null for non-content-mutating actions (e.g., soft-delete snapshot).
The post body content AFTER the edit/action (if applicable). Null for non-content-mutating actions (e.g., soft-delete snapshot).

new_body.description: The post body content AFTER the edit/action (if applicable). Null for non-content-mutating actions (e.g., soft-delete snapshot).

edit_type.description: Type of edit/action that led to this post history snapshot—e.g., 'edit', 'delete', 'restore', etc. Used for filtering and workflow analysis.

oneOf.description: Explanation/reason for the edit/action as recorded by the member or moderator. Nullable; may be blank for simple auto-edits.
Explanation/reason for the edit/action as recorded by the member or moderator. Nullable; may be blank for simple auto-edits.

edit_reason.description: Explanation/reason for the edit/action as recorded by the member or moderator. Nullable; may be blank for simple auto-edits.

created_at.description: Timestamp for when this history/snapshot record was created, in ISO8601/RFC3339 format.

IPostHistory.description:
A snapshot representing an edit, deletion, or moderation action on a post, recorded for audit and moderation purposes. Models the structure of the discussionboard_post_histories entity as a normalized audit log.

Each history record can contain both the old and new post body, as well as the edit type, editor, and timing. The record acts as an immutable log for resolving disputes, supporting appeals, or compliance audits. Not all entries have both old_body and new_body (e.g., creation/deletion snapshots may be partly empty).

edit_type.description: If present, new edit type for the post edit history snapshot. Used for corrections, e.g., changing 'temp-delete' to 'delete'.

edit_reason.description: Updated reason for the edit (if changed/clarified as part of audit or member edit).

new_body.description: Updated post body after the edit (if changing previously submitted body).

IPostHistory.IUpdate.description:
Request body for updating a post edit history record. Permits mutation of:
- edit_type (reason for the update)
- edit_reason (moderator/user-supplied reason for change)
- new_body (post content after the change)

id, discussionboard_post_id, and edit_member_id are always immutable and absent from this update type.

discussionboard_post_id.description: (Optional) The post id for which to filter edit log records.

edit_member_id.description: (Optional) Member id who performed the edit in log. Use to filter for own activity or moderator/admin searches.

change_summary.description: (Optional) Filter for edit records where the change_summary field matches the query.

created_at_from.description: (Optional) Lower bound for edit log's creation timestamp (inclusive).

created_at_to.description: (Optional) Upper bound for edit log's creation timestamp (inclusive).

IPostEditLog.IRequest.description: Request shape for searching/editing log entries for posts. All query properties are optional filters. May include post id, editor id, summary filter, and creation date time window. Used for audit, compliance, and member transparency features.

pagination.description: Page info for result window, including current/limit/total/records/etc per the IPage.IPagination contract.

data.description: List of post edit log records for the current result page. Each follows the IPostEditLog schema.

IPageIPostEditLog.description: A paginated page of post edit log records, supporting scalable audit and compliance review. Used in moderator/member/admin audit trails.

id.description: Primary key for this post edit log record. UUID assigned at log creation.

discussionboard_post_id.description: Foreign key: references the post edited in this action.

edit_member_id.description: Foreign key: references the member who performed this edit.

change_summary.description: Short, human-readable summary describing the change for this log entry. Used to help users/moderators quickly scan audit history.

change_details.description: Long-form or structured JSON/text containing detailed information about the edit. Used for compliance and dispute resolution.

created_at.description: Timestamp for when the edit log was created, in ISO8601/RFC3339 format.

IPostEditLog.description: A single record of a post edit, forming an audit trail for moderation and compliance. Matches discussionboard_post_edit_logs schema in the backend. Used for investigation, member transparency, and UI review of edit history.

change_summary.description:
A brief summary describing the change made during an edit operation. This field is used for audit purposes and is required as part of the post edit log update request. For example: 'Corrected spelling mistake.'

This corresponds to the 'change_summary' column in the discussionboard_post_edit_logs table, which maintains a concise history of what was changed each time a post is edited. Required when updating an edit log entry.

change_details.description:
A detailed description or JSON string capturing exactly what was changed during the post edit operation. This often includes before/after text or specific field changes, supporting audit, compliance, and rollback requirements. For example: '{"from":"draft","to":"final"}'.

This maps to the 'change_details' column in discussionboard_post_edit_logs and is required in post edit log update requests for record completeness and compliance review.

IPostEditLog.IUpdate.description: Update type for post edit log. Covers required information for amending a post's modification history in compliance with thread editing and auditing requirements. See discussionboard_post_edit_logs for column details.

thread_id.description: Filter by thread id (discussionboard_thread_archives.discussionboard_thread_id). Only accepts UUID values. Useful for searching all archival events related to a specific thread.

archived_by_member_id.description: Filter by the member id who performed the archival (discussionboard_thread_archives.archived_by_member_id). Only accepts UUID. Used for moderator or admin audit filtering.

archive_reason.description: Search or filter by reason provided when the thread was archived. This is a free text string (discussionboard_thread_archives.archive_reason) and allows keyword search for moderation policy analysis.

created_from.description: Start of date/time window for archival event filtering. Used to find thread archives since a certain time. Must be in ISO 8601 timestamp format.

created_to.description: End of date/time window for archival event filtering. Used to find thread archives before a certain cutoff. Must be in ISO 8601 timestamp format.

page.description: Page number for paginated results. Must be at least 1. Used for UI paging.

limit.description: Maximum number of archive events returned per page. Default: 100. Used for UI paging.

IThreadArchive.IRequest.description: Request type for searching, filtering, and paginating thread archive records. All fields are optional filters; pagination supported. See discussionboard_thread_archives for columns.

data.description: Array of thread archive records for the current page.

IPageIThreadArchive.description: Paginated result type for thread archive records, combining pagination information and an array of results.

discussionboard_thread_id.description: Foreign key to the thread being archived (discussionboard_thread_archives.discussionboard_thread_id). Indicates which thread this record is referencing.

archived_by_member_id.description: Member id for the user who performed the archival (discussionboard_thread_archives.archived_by_member_id). Used for audit logs and accountability.

archive_reason.description: Textual reason or comment explaining why the thread was archived (discussionboard_thread_archives.archive_reason). Provides context and compliance trail for archival decisions.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the archival event was recorded (discussionboard_thread_archives.created_at). Used for historical ordering and audit purposes.

IThreadArchive.description: Thread archive entity. Represents archival (soft-deletion/lockout) of a thread with moderator/admin reason and audit info. Schema strictly follows the columns in discussionboard_thread_archives.

archive_reason.description: Textual reason for archival update. This field is used when a moderator or admin needs to modify the reason that was initially recorded for archiving the thread. Aligned to discussionboard_thread_archives.archive_reason.

IDiscussionboardThreadArchive.IUpdate.description: Request type for updating a thread archive. Used to modify the archival reason post-facto by permitted users or admins. Constraints and audit requirements follow business/compliance rules.

id.description: Primary key for the thread archive entity (discussionboard_thread_archives.id).

discussionboard_thread_id.description: Foreign key to the thread being archived (discussionboard_thread_archives.discussionboard_thread_id).

archived_by_member_id.description: Member id for user who performed the archival (discussionboard_thread_archives.archived_by_member_id).

archive_reason.description: Textual reason or audit comment for the archival event (discussionboard_thread_archives.archive_reason). Provides compliance and decision tracking.

created_at.description: Timestamp of archival event entry (discussionboard_thread_archives.created_at).

IDiscussionboardThreadArchive.description: Thread archive record as returned from system for a specific thread archive operation. Includes full context and audit trail fields.

report_reason.description: Text or keyword for searching/reporting by the stated reason for reporting a post/comment. Refers to discussionboard_content_reports.report_reason and enables moderation queue or analytics filtering.

reporter_member_id.description: Member id (discussionboard_content_reports.reporter_member_id) for filtering reports submitted by a specific authenticated user. Useful for user audit, self-analytics, or moderation investigation.

reporter_guest_id.description: Guest id (discussionboard_content_reports.reporter_guest_id) for guest-origin reports; allows checking unregistered/untracked abuse patterns.

status.description: Status of moderation review process (discussionboard_content_reports.status). Accepts enum values such as 'pending', 'in_review', 'action_taken', or 'dismissed'. Used for queue triage and workflow.

reported_from.description: ISO 8601 start time filter for reports, corresponding to reported_at column in discussionboard_content_reports.

reported_to.description: ISO 8601 end time filter for reports by reported_at time.

page.description: Page number for paginated report results.

limit.description: Maximum number of result items per page, default 100.

data.description: Page of content report details for search or moderation review.

IPageIContentReport.description: Paginated list of reports filtered/searched from discussionboard_content_reports, core output for moderation/analytics UIs.

moderator_note.description: Comment or note by moderator reviewing the report (discussionboard_content_reports.moderator_note).

moderator_id.description:
The unique identifier of the moderator who issued the suspension. Maps to discussionboard_moderators.id.

This field enables traceability of disciplinary actions for compliance and audit purposes. Required to assign accountability for issuing a suspension.

suspended_member_id.description:
The unique identifier of the member being suspended. Maps to discussionboard_members.id.

This property enables linking the suspension to the affected member, supporting enforcement, compliance, and reactivation logic.

suspension_reason.description:
A clear textual explanation for why the suspension was issued (e.g., 'spamming', 'abuse of rules').

This field documents justification for the action, supporting transparency, appeals, and moderation review.

suspension_started_at.description:
The timestamp (RFC 3339) for when the suspension takes effect.

This supports audit trailing and timezone-independent policy enforcement.

oneOf.description:
The scheduled end timestamp (RFC 3339) for the suspension. Nullable for indefinite or until manual review.

This field enables temporary or permanent suspension durations as per business rules.

suspension_reason.description: Updated reason for the suspension in case of administrative correction or additional details.
